Culture Clips bo'limining 5-mavzusi: 'Festive Fun' (bayram quvonchi). Bosilgan bet raqami: 162.

Betda:
• Sarlavha: '5 Festive Fun'
• 'Pre-reading Activity' — 1-mashq (rasmlar)
• 'Reading' — 2a (L/M/C belgilash, 6 ta gap), 2b (ona tiliga o'xshash so'zlar), 2c (sinonimlar)
• BIRINChI MATN — 'The Lord Mayor's Show' (sariq fonda, o'ng yuqorida)

⚠ C, D, E suratlari, May Festivals matni, Cowes Week matni, 'Calendar of Events' jadvali va 'Speaking' — hammasi 163-betda.

sections.title: Festive Fun (1) - The Lord Mayor's Show

exercises.instructionEn: 1  Look at the pictures. How are they related to the title? Which shows: The Lord Mayor in a gold coach? a firework display? a maypole dance? a yachting event? a May Queen?
exercises.instructionUz: 1  Rasmlarga qarang. Ular sarlavha bilan qanday bog'liq? Qaysi birida: oltin aravadagi Lord Mer? salyut? may ustuni raqsi? yaxta poygasi? May malikasi bor?
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'PRE-READING ACTIVITY' —
matnni o'qishdan OLDINGI mashq.


⚠ BIRINChI SAVOL:
  'How are they related to the title?'
     = Ular sarlavha bilan qanday bog'liq?

  JAVOB: hammasi BAYRAM va TANTANA —
  sarlavha 'FESTIVE FUN' (bayram quvonchi)
  aynan shu haqda.


JAVOBLAR:

  A  — The Lord Mayor in a gold coach
         (oltin aravadagi Lord Mer)  162-bet
  B  — a yachting event
         (yaxta poygasi)             162-bet
  C  — a May Queen
         (May malikasi)              163-bet
  D  — a maypole dance
         (may ustuni raqsi)          163-bet
  E  — a firework display
         (salyut)                    163-bet


⚠ 'THE LORD MAYOR' KIM:

  'the Lord Mayor' = Lord Mer —
  London Sitisining rasmiy boshlig'i.

  ⚠ 'a mayor' = mer (shahar hokimi).
  ⚠ O'qilishi: BrE [MEE-uh] yoki [mair].

  ⚠ 'the Lord Mayor of London' va
  'the Mayor of London' — IKKI BOShQA
  lavozim! Birinchisi — qadimiy marosim
  lavozimi (faqat Siti uchun), ikkinchisi —
  butun shaharning saylangan hokimi.


⚠ 'A MAYPOLE' NIMA:

  'a maypole' = 'May' + 'pole' (ustun)

  Bahor bayramida o'rnatiladigan baland
  ustun. Uchiga rangli lentalar bog'lanadi,
  odamlar lentani ushlab ustun atrofida
  aylanib raqsga tushishadi.

  ⚠ 'a pole' — 156-betdagi 'a totem pole'
  da ham shu so'z bor edi.


⚠ 'A MAY QUEEN' KIM:

  May bayramida tanlanadigan yosh qiz.
  Boshiga gulchambar kiydiriladi va u
  saylga boshchilik qiladi.

  ⚠ C suratda: oq ko'ylakli, boshida toj
  bo'lgan qiz va uning atrofida qizil-oq
  kiyimdagi bolalar.


⚠ 'A FIREWORK DISPLAY':

  'a display' = namoyish, ko'rgazma

  ⚠ 'a firework display' = salyut
  namoyishi.

  ⚠ 'display' — 2c mashqidagi ta'kidlangan
  so'z (sinonimi: 'show').

  ⚠ 160-betdagi 'firecrackers' (petarda)
  bilan adashtirmang.


⚠ 'YACHTING' va 'SAILING':

     'a yacht' [yot] = yaxta
        ⚠ 'ch' JIM!
     'yachting' = yaxta sporti
     'sailing' = yelkanda suzish

  ⚠ 'a sail' = yelkan; 'to sail' = suzmoq.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  festive     = bayramona
  a festival  = bayram
  a mayor     = mer, shahar hokimi
  a coach     = arava; avtobus
  a display   = namoyish
  a maypole   = may ustuni
  a pole      = ustun
  a yacht     = yaxta
  yachting    = yaxta sporti
  sailing     = yelkanda suzish
  related to  = ... bilan bog'liq

⚠ 'an event' = tadbir.

163-betdagi May Festivals matnida: 'They

⚠ May malikasi — bahor bayramida tanlanadigan

163-betdagi matnda: 'the local people dance

⚠ 'a maypole' = 'May' + 'pole' (ustun).
Uchiga rangli lentalar bog'lanadi.

⚠ 'a pole' — 156-betdagi 'totem pole' da

IKKALA matnda ham bor:

Lord Mayor: 'At the end of the parade there
is a SPECTACULAR FIREWORK DISPLAY.'
Cowes Week: 'On the last day there is a huge
FIREWORK DISPLAY.'

⚠ 'a display' = namoyish (2c mashqidagi
so'z, sinonimi 'show').

⚠ 160-betdagi 'firecrackers' (petarda) bilan
adashtirmang.

exercises.instructionEn: READING TEXT 1 - THE LORD MAYOR'S SHOW: a colourful London tradition which started in 1215.
exercises.instructionUz: 1-MATN — LORD MER SAYLI: 1215-yildan beri davom etayotgan rang-barang London an'anasi.
exercises.explanationUz:
BIRINChI MATN — THE LORD MAYOR'S SHOW.


TO'LIQ MATN:

  'The Lord Mayor's Show is a colourful
   London tradition which started in 1215
   and takes place every November. The
   Lord MAYOR is the person who makes
   important DECISIONS about the city.

   During the show he travels through
   central London in a gold coach at the
   front of a large PARADE. There are
   soldiers, marching bands, horses and
   brightly-coloured floats in the parade.
   People wear beautiful COSTUMES and
   follow the coach as they listen to the
   BANDS playing.

   The whole PROCESSION is nearly four
   kilometres long. It is the largest
   parade of its kind in the world. The
   streets are full of people who come to
   watch and CHEER just as they did when
   the famous Dick Whittington was Lord
   Mayor in 1397. Nowadays, the crowds
   BLOW WHISTLES and wave UNION JACK
   flags. At the end of the parade there
   is a SPECTACULAR firework DISPLAY.'


TARJIMASI:

  'Lord Mer sayli — 1215-yilda boshlangan va
   har yili noyabrda o'tkaziladigan rang-barang
   London an'anasi. Lord Mer — shahar haqida
   muhim qarorlar qabul qiladigan shaxs.

   Sayl davomida u katta saylning eng oldida,
   oltin aravada London markazidan o'tadi.
   Saylda askarlar, yurish orkestrlari, otlar
   va yorqin bo'yalgan bezakli aravalar bor.
   Odamlar go'zal liboslar kiyib, orkestr
   sadolarini tinglagancha arava ortidan
   ergashadi.

   Butun kortej qariyb to'rt kilometr uzunlikda.
   Bu — dunyodagi shu turdagi eng katta sayl.
   Ko'chalar tomosha qilib olqishlaydigan
   odamlarga to'la — xuddi 1397-yilda mashhur
   Dik Uittington Lord Mer bo'lgan paytdagi
   kabi. Hozirgi kunda olomon hushtak chalib,
   Britaniya bayrog'ini silkitadi. Sayl oxirida
   ajoyib salyut bo'ladi.'


⚠ 'THE UNION JACK' NIMA:

  'the Union Jack' = Buyuk Britaniya
  bayrog'i (ko'k fonda oq va qizil xochlar).

  ⚠ Uch bayroqning birlashmasi:
     Angliya (qizil xoch)
     Shotlandiya (oq qiya xoch)
     Irlandiya (qizil qiya xoch)

  ⚠ Shuning uchun 'UNION' (birlashma).


⚠ 'A FLOAT' — QIZIQ SO'Z:

  'a float' = sayldagi bezatilgan arava
  (yuk mashinasi ustiga qurilgan bezak)

  ⚠ 'to float' = suzib yurmoq (suvda)

  ⚠ Nomi shundan: arava sekin, go'yo
  suzib borayotgandek harakatlanadi.


⚠ 'A BAND' — KO'P MA'NOLI:

     'a band' = orkestr, musiqa guruhi
        'marching bands' = yurish
           orkestrlari
     'a band' = tasma, bog'ich
     'a rubber band' = rezinka


⚠ 'TO CHEER' = OLQIShLAMOQ:

  'people who come to watch and CHEER'

  ⚠ 'to cheer' = ovoz chiqarib olqishlamoq,
  quvvatlamoq.

  ⚠ 'Cheers!' — qadah so'zi yoki
  'rahmat/xayr' (Britaniyada).


⚠ 'JUST AS THEY DID' — TAKRORLANIShNI
  OLDINI OLISh:

  'come to watch and cheer JUST AS THEY
   DID when Dick Whittington was Lord
   Mayor'

  ⚠ 'did' bu yerda 'watched and cheered'
  o'rniga turibdi.

  ⚠ Ingliz tilida fe'lni takrorlamaslik
  uchun 'do/does/did' ishlatiladi:
     'She sings better than I DO.'
     ('than I sing' o'rniga)


⚠ 'WHICH' va 'WHO':

  'a tradition WHICH started in 1215'
     → NARSA uchun 'which'

  'the person WHO makes decisions'
     → ODAM uchun 'who'

  'people WHO come to watch'
     → ODAM uchun 'who'

  ⚠ Bu betda ikkalasi ham bor —
  taqqoslash uchun juda qulay.


⚠ DIK UITTINGTON KIM:

  Richard Whittington (taxminan 1354-1423)
  — haqiqiy tarixiy shaxs, 1397-yilda
  London meri bo'lgan.

  ⚠ Ingliz xalq ertagida u kambag'al bola
  sifatida tasvirlanadi — mushugi bilan
  Londonga kelib, boy bo'ladi. Bu — ertak,
  lekin odamning o'zi haqiqiy.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a decision  = qaror
  to decide   = qaror qilmoq
  a parade    = sayl, parad
  a procession = kortej, yurish
  a float     = bezatilgan arava
  a band      = orkestr; tasma
  a costume   = libos
  to cheer    = olqishlamoq
  a whistle   = hushtak
  to blow     = puflamoq, chalmoq
  to wave     = silkitmoq
  the Union Jack = Britaniya bayrog'i
  spectacular = ajoyib, hayratlanarli
  a display   = namoyish
  to take place = o'tkazilmoq

points.en: The Lord Mayor's Show is a colourful London tradition which started in 1215 and takes place every November.
points.uz: Lord Mer sayli — 1215-yilda boshlangan va har yili noyabrda o'tkaziladigan rang-barang London an'anasi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'WHICH' — NARSA uchun ('a tradition').

⚠ 'to TAKE PLACE' = o'tkazilmoq, bo'lib
o'tmoq ('to happen' bilan ma'nodosh, lekin
rejalashtirilgan tadbir uchun).

⚠ 1215 — Magna Carta yili; sayl shu
qadimiy.

⚠ 'colourful' TA'KIDLANMAGAN — u shunchaki
sariq fonda turgan oddiy matn.

points.en: The Lord Mayor is the person who makes important decisions about the city.
points.uz: Lord Mer — shahar haqida muhim qarorlar qabul qiladigan shaxs.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'WHO' — ODAM uchun ('the person').

⚠ 'to MAKE a decision' — 'to do' EMAS!
  'make a decision'  ✓
  'do a decision'    ✗

⚠ Photo File 14-unit varag'idagi 'do/make' farqiga qarang.

⚠ 'to decide' (fe'l) → 'a decision' (ot).

points.en: During the show he travels through central London in a gold coach at the front of a large parade.
points.uz: Sayl davomida u katta saylning eng oldida, oltin aravada London markazidan o'tadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a coach' IKKI MA'NODA: ot aravasi va
sayohat avtobusi. Bu yerda — ARAVA.

⚠ 'at the FRONT of' = eng oldida
(ichkarida);
'IN FRONT of' = oldida (tashqarida).
Nozik farq!

⚠ 'DURING' + OT.

points.en: There are soldiers, marching bands, horses and brightly-coloured floats in the parade.
points.uz: Saylda askarlar, yurish orkestrlari, otlar va yorqin bo'yalgan bezakli aravalar bor.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bu gap 2a mashqining 6-bandiga javob: L
(saylda OTLAR bor).

⚠ 'a FLOAT' = sayldagi bezatilgan arava.
'to float' = suzib yurmoq — nomi shundan
(arava go'yo suzib borayotgandek).

⚠ 'brightly-coloured' — defis bilan qo'shma
sifat.

points.en: The whole procession is nearly four kilometres long. It is the largest parade of its kind in the world.
points.uz: Butun kortej qariyb to'rt kilometr uzunlikda. Bu — dunyodagi shu turdagi eng katta sayl.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'four kilometres LONG' — raqam oldin,
sifat keyin (155-betdagi '50 km long' bilan
bir xil).

⚠ 'of its KIND' = shu TURDAGI.

⚠ 'nearly' = qariyb, deyarli
(= 'almost').

points.en: The streets are full of people who come to watch and cheer just as they did when Dick Whittington was Lord Mayor in 1397.
points.uz: Ko'chalar tomosha qilib olqishlaydigan odamlarga to'la — xuddi 1397-yilda Dik Uittington Lord Mer bo'lgan paytdagi kabi.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ 'JUST AS THEY DID' — 'did' bu yerda
'watched and cheered' o'rniga turibdi.

Ingliz tilida fe'lni takrorlamaslik uchun
'do/does/did' ishlatiladi:
'She sings better than I DO.'

⚠ Dik Uittington — HAQIQIY tarixiy shaxs
(1397-yilda London meri). Ingliz ertagida
esa mushugi bilan boy bo'lgan kambag'al bola.

points.en: Nowadays, the crowds blow whistles and wave Union Jack flags.
points.uz: Hozirgi kunda olomon hushtak chalib, Britaniya bayrog'ini silkitadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bu gap 2a mashqining 2-bandiga javob: L.

⚠ 'to BLOW a whistle' = hushtak ChALMOQ
(so'zma-so'z: 'puflamoq').

⚠ 'the UNION JACK' = Britaniya bayrog'i.
Uch bayroqning BIRLAShMASI: Angliya,
Shotlandiya, Irlandiya xochlari — shuning
uchun 'UNION'.

points.en: At the end of the parade there is a spectacular firework display.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ Bu gap 2a mashqining 5-bandiga javob —
LEKIN Cowes Week matnida ham AYNI ShUNDAY

⚠ 'spectacular' va 'display' — 2c
mashqidagi ta'kidlangan so'zlar
(sinonimlari: 'fantastic' va 'show').

exercises.instructionEn: 2  a) Read the texts and answer the questions (1-6). Write (L) for the Lord Mayor's Show, (M) for May Festivals and (C) for Cowes Week. Then explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: 2  a) Matnlarni o'qing va savollarga javob bering (1-6). (L) — Lord Mer sayli, (M) — May bayramlari, (C) — Cowes haftaligi deb yozing. So'ng qalin harfli so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠⚠ UCh MATNNI TAQQOSLASh MAShQI.

  L = the Lord Mayor's Show  (162-bet)
  M = May Festivals          (163-bet)
  C = Cowes Week             (163-bet)

  ⚠ 160-betdagi mashqda IKKI variant bor
  edi (NY/L); bu yerda UChTA.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  C    — tomoshabin qayiqlari
  2  L    — hushtak va Union Jack
  3  M    — gullar bezak sifatida
  4  M    — maxsus raqslar
  5  L va C  ⚠⚠ IKKALASI HAM!
  6  L    — saylda otlar bor


⚠⚠ 5-BAND — KITOBDAGI KAMChILIK:

  Gap: 'There is a firework display.'

  ⚠ Bu gap IKKI MATNGA ham to'g'ri keladi:

     Lord Mayor's Show:
        'At the end of the parade there is
         a spectacular FIREWORK DISPLAY.'

     Cowes Week:
        'On the last day there is a huge
         FIREWORK DISPLAY.'

  ⚠ Ya'ni javob HAM 'L', HAM 'C'.

  ⚠ Kitob bitta harf kutgan bo'lsa kerak,
  lekin matnlar ikkalasini ham tasdiqlaydi.
  Ikkalasini yozish TO'G'RI bo'ladi.


⚠⚠ 6-BAND — TUZOQ:

  Gap: 'There are horses in the
        procession.'

  ⚠ To'g'ri javob: L
     ('There are soldiers, marching bands,
       HORSES and floats in the parade.')

  ⚠ TUZOQ: May Festivals matnida ham 'HORSE'
  so'zi bor — 'the HOBBY HORSE Festival'.

  LEKIN 'a hobby horse' — HAQIQIY OT EMAS!
  Bu — odam kiyadigan ot ShAKLIDAGI LIBOS.

  Matnda aniq: 'Two men wear COSTUMES and
  MASKS'.

  ⚠ Shuning uchun javob M emas, L.


⚠ 3 va 4-BANDLAR IKKALASI HAM 'M':

  3) gullar bezak sifatida:
     'a maypole which is DECORATED WITH
      FLOWERS and ribbons'
     'Morris Dancers wear FLOWERS'
     'decorate the drinking wells with
      pictures made from clay and FLOWERS'

  4) maxsus raqslar:
     'Morris Dancers ... PERFORM A SPECIAL
      DANCE'
     'the local people DANCE around a
      maypole'


⚠ 'TO PERFORM' = IJRO ETMOQ:

     'perform a dance' = raqs ijro etmoq
     'perform a song'  = qo'shiq aytmoq

  ⚠ 'a performance' = tomosha, chiqish.

items.textEn: 1  You can watch the event from special boats.
items.uz: Tadbirni maxsus qayiqlardan tomosha qilish mumkin.
items.whyUz:
⚠ COWES WEEK (C).

163-betdagi matnda: 'Thousands of people
watch from the port or from one of the
hundreds of SPECTATOR BOATS.'

⚠ 'a spectator' = tomoshabin.
⚠ 'a spectator boat' = tomoshabinlar uchun
qayiq.

⚠ Cowes Week — dengizda o'tadi, shuning
uchun qayiqdan tomosha qilinadi.

items.textEn: 2  Crowds blow whistles and wave Union Jacks.
items.uz: Olomon hushtak chalib, Britaniya bayrog'ini silkitadi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ LORD MAYOR'S SHOW (L).

162-betdagi matnda: 'Nowadays, the crowds
BLOW WHISTLES and wave UNION JACK flags.'

⚠ Bu gap deyarli so'zma-so'z matndan
olingan.

⚠ 'the Union Jack' = Britaniya bayrog'i.

⚠ MAY FESTIVALS (M).

163-betdagi matnda gullar UCH marta tilga
olingan:
  'a maypole DECORATED WITH FLOWERS and
   ribbons'
  'Morris Dancers wear FLOWERS and bells'
  'decorate the drinking wells with pictures
   made from clay and FLOWERS'

⚠ May bayrami — BAHOR bayrami, shuning uchun
gullar asosiy bezak.

⚠ MAY FESTIVALS (M).

163-betdagi matnda: 'Morris Dancers wear
flowers and bells and PERFORM A SPECIAL
DANCE.'

⚠ Yana: 'the local people DANCE around a
maypole'.

⚠ 'to perform' = ijro etmoq.
⚠ Morris Dancers — Angliyaning qadimiy
xalq raqs guruhlari; oyoqlariga qo'ng'iroq
bog'lashadi.

⚠⚠ IKKALASI HAM — BU BETDAGI ENG MUHIM
KUZATUV.

LORD MAYOR'S SHOW (162-bet):
'At the end of the parade there is a
spectacular FIREWORK DISPLAY.'

COWES WEEK (163-bet):
'On the last day there is a huge FIREWORK
DISPLAY.'

⚠ Kitob bitta harf kutgan bo'lsa kerak,
lekin MATNLAR IKKALASINI HAM tasdiqlaydi.

⚠ Shuning uchun 'L va C' deb yozish to'g'ri.
Faqat bittasini yozish matnga to'liq mos
kelmaydi.

items.textEn: 6  There are horses in the procession.
items.whyUz:
⚠ LORD MAYOR'S SHOW (L).

162-betdagi matnda: 'There are soldiers,
marching bands, HORSES and brightly-coloured
floats in the parade.'

⚠⚠ TUZOQ: May Festivals matnida ham 'horse'
so'zi bor — 'the HOBBY HORSE Festival'.

LEKIN 'a hobby horse' — HAQIQIY OT EMAS!
Bu — odam kiyadigan ot shaklidagi LIBOS.
Matnda aniq: 'Two men wear COSTUMES and
MASKS'.

⚠ Shuning uchun javob M emas, L.

exercises.instructionEn: 2  c) Match the highlighted words to their synonyms: show, welcoming, beautiful, fantastic, ideal, customs.
exercises.instructionUz: 2  c) Ta'kidlangan so'zlarni sinonimlari bilan moslang: show, welcoming, beautiful, fantastic, ideal, customs.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ TA'KIDLANGAN SO'ZLAR IKKI BETGA
TARQALGAN:

  162-betda:  spectacular, display
  163-betda:  traditions, pretty, perfect,
              friendly

  ⚠ Jami OLTITA — ro'yxatdagi sinonimlar
  soni ham OLTITA.


⚠ DIQQAT — ADAShTIRMANG:

  Lord Mayor matnidagi 'colourful' so'zi
  TA'KIDLANMAGAN. U shunchaki SARIQ FONDA
  turgan oddiy matn.

  ⚠ Butun matn qutisi sariq rangda —
  shuning uchun birinchi qarashda
  ta'kidlangandek ko'rinadi.


BARCHA JUFTLAR:

  spectacular  →  fantastic
                  (ajoyib)
  display      →  show
                  (namoyish)
  traditions   →  customs
                  (an'analar, urf-odatlar)
  pretty       →  beautiful
                  (chiroyli)
  perfect      →  ideal
                  (mukammal)
  friendly     →  welcoming
                  (mehmondo'st)


⚠ QIZIQ NARSA — 'DISPLAY' va 'SHOW':

  Ikkalasi ham 'namoyish' degani.

  ⚠ Va matnning SARLAVhASIDA ham 'SHOW'
  bor: 'The Lord Mayor's SHOW'!

  ⚠ Ya'ni 'a firework display' =
  'a firework show'.


⚠ 'PRETTY' — IKKI VAZIFA:

  1) SIFAT: chiroyli
     'a PRETTY young girl'
     ← bu yerda shu

  2) RAVISh: ancha, ancha-muncha
     'It's PRETTY cold today.'
     = Bugun ancha sovuq.

  ⚠ Ikkinchi ma'no juda ko'p ishlatiladi!


⚠ 'CUSTOMS' — IKKI MA'NO:

     'customs' = urf-odatlar, an'analar
        ← bu yerda shu
     'Customs' = BOJXONA (aeroportda)

  ⚠ 'a customer' esa — MIJOZ (butunlay
  boshqa so'z!).


⚠ 'FRIENDLY' — SIFAT, RAVISh EMAS:

  ⚠ '-ly' bilan tugagani uchun ko'pchilik
  uni ravish deb o'ylaydi — XATO!

     'a friendly island'  ✓ (sifat)
     'He smiled friendly' ✗
     'He smiled in a friendly way' ✓

  ⚠ Shu kabi: lovely, lonely, silly,
  ugly — hammasi SIFAT.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  spectacular = ajoyib, hayratlanarli
  fantastic   = zo'r, ajoyib
  a display   = namoyish
  a show      = tomosha, namoyish
  a tradition = an'ana
  a custom    = urf-odat
  pretty      = chiroyli; ancha
  perfect     = mukammal
  ideal       = ideal, eng mos
  friendly    = mehribon, mehmondo'st
  welcoming   = mehmondo'st

pairs.whyUz:
Matnda: 'a SPECTACULAR firework display'.

⚠ 'spectacular' — 'a spectacle' (tomosha)
dan; 'spectator' (tomoshabin) bilan bir
ildizdan.

⚠ 163-betdagi Cowes Week matnida
'SPECTATOR boats' bor — shu ildiz.

Matnda: 'a spectacular firework DISPLAY'.

⚠⚠ QIZIQ: matnning SARLAVHASIDA ham 'SHOW'
bor — 'The Lord Mayor's SHOW'!

Ya'ni 'a firework display' = 'a firework
show'.

⚠ 'to display' (fe'l) = namoyish qilmoq.

163-betdagi May Festivals matnida: 'there
are lots of different TRADITIONS and
festivals'.

⚠⚠ 'customs' IKKI MA'NODA:
  urf-odatlar ← bu yerda shu
  BOJXONA (aeroportda)

⚠ 'a customer' esa — MIJOZ, butunlay boshqa
so'z!

163-betdagi matnda: 'They also choose a
PRETTY young girl to be the May Queen.'

⚠⚠ 'pretty' IKKI VAZIFADA:
  SIFAT: chiroyli ← bu yerda shu
  RAVISH: ancha ('It's pretty cold.')

⚠ Ikkinchi ma'no so'zlashuvda juda ko'p
ishlatiladi.

163-betdagi Cowes Week matnida: 'The sea
around the island is PERFECT for sailing.'

⚠ 'perfect FOR' — 'for' bilan.

⚠ 'ideal' — 157-betdagi Vankuver matnida
ham bor edi: 'Vancouver is an IDEAL city.'
⚠ O'qilishi: [ay-DIL].

163-betdagi matnda: 'everybody has a great
time on this FRIENDLY and beautiful island'.

⚠⚠ 'friendly' — SIFAT, ravish EMAS!
'-ly' bilan tugagani chalg'itadi:
  'a friendly island'  ✓
  'He smiled friendly' ✗
  'in a friendly way'  ✓

⚠ 'to welcome' (kutib olmoq) →
'welcoming' (mehmondo'st).

exercises.instructionEn: 2  b) Read the texts again. Are there any words similar to words in your language?
exercises.instructionUz: 2  b) Matnlarni yana o'qing. Ona tilingizdagi so'zlarga o'xshash so'zlar bormi?
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 158-betdagi 2b mashqi bilan bir xil
turdagi vazifa — o'xshash so'zlarni topish.


UCh MATNDAN TOPILGAN SO'ZLAR:

  festival    — festival
  tradition   — tradisiya
  parade      — parad
  procession  — protsessiya
  costume     — kostyum
  carnival    — karnaval
  calendar    — kalendar
  regatta     — regata
  yacht       — yaxta
  port        — port
  club        — klub
  ball        — bal (raqs kechasi)
  public      — publika
  musician    — muzikant
  mask        — maska
  royal       — korol (rus tili orqali)
  arts        — art (san'at)


⚠ NEGA BUNChA KO'P?

  Bu so'zlarning ko'pi LOTIN yoki FRANSUZ
  tilidan kelgan — ular Yevropaning
  ko'p tillariga, jumladan rus tili orqali
  o'zbek tiliga ham kirgan.


⚠ IKKI QIZIQ SO'Z:

  1) 'REGATTA' — italyan tilidan
     (Venetsiyadagi qayiq poygasi nomi).
     ⚠ 163-betdagi kalendarda:
     'Henley Royal REGATTA' (iyul).

  2) 'CARNIVAL' — lotincha 'carne vale'
     ('go'sht bilan xayrlashuv').
     ⚠ Ro'zadan oldingi bayram bo'lgan.
     ⚠ Kalendarda: 'Notting Hill CARNIVAL'
     (avgust).


⚠ EhTIYOT BO'LING — SOXTA DO'STLAR:

     'a ball' = 1) to'p  2) BAL (raqs
        kechasi) ← Cowes Week matnida
        shu ma'noda
     'public' = 1) ommaviy  2) jamoat
        ⚠ 'publika' (tomoshabinlar)
        inglizchada 'the audience'
     'a band' = orkestr
        ⚠ 'banda' EMAS!


⚠ 158-BETDAGI MAShQNI ESLANG:

  U yerda 'sugar/shakar' va 'tea/choy'
  juftliklari bor edi — ular ChUQURROQ
  qarindosh so'zlar edi.

  Bu yerdagilar esa asosan YAQINDA
  o'zlashgan xalqaro so'zlar.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  similar to  = ... ga o'xshash
  a language  = til
  a regatta   = regata (qayiq poygasi)
  a carnival  = karnaval
  a ball      = bal (raqs kechasi); to'p
  public      = ommaviy, jamoat

kelgan va ko'p tillarga tarqalgan.

inglizchada 'THE AUDIENCE'.
